# Summarise heteroscedasticity test results

<small>Source: [`R/advancedDiagnostics.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/advancedDiagnostics.R) · Help: `?compareTestResults`</small>

Runs selected diagnostics for a single model and returns a tidy
data frame of test statistics and p-values.

## Usage

```r
compareTestResults(model, data = NULL, tests = c("white", "koenker"))
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted `lm` model or a formula.

`data`
:   Data frame used if `model` is a formula.

`tests`
:   Character vector of heteroscedasticity tests. Defaults to the
    White and Koenker tests, the default of [`runHeteroTests()`](runHeteroTests.md); it was the
    White and the classical Breusch-Pagan tests up to 0.14.0.

## Value

Data frame with columns `test`, `statistic`, and `p.value`.

## Examples

```r
data(mtcars)
m <- lm(mpg ~ wt + qsec, mtcars)
compareTestResults(m)
```
